planets.name: Kadaku
planets.notes: Primary Tyranid front. Dense terrain, promethium infrastructure.

planets.name: Avarax
planets.notes: Largest mission pool. Mixed Tyranid/Chaos presence.

planets.name: Demerium
planets.notes: Primary Chaos front. All Chaos-only missions force Intelligence Lapse.

planets.name: Wrath of Espandor
planets.notes: Dauntless-class cruiser operating in the Jericho Reach. Always in the eligible op pool regardless of committed planet — no gate, no unlock condition. Reclamation (Op 11) is the only mission run here.

roaming_terminus.name: Neurothrope
roaming_terminus.eligible_maps: Any Tyranid or Mixed mission (including Intel Lapse converted)

roaming_terminus.name: Carnifex
roaming_terminus.eligible_maps: Any Tyranid or Mixed mission (including Intel Lapse converted)

terminus_rules.fixed_boss_missions: Fixed terminus boss is the only terminus target — no roaming spawns on these missions.
terminus_rules.roaming_eligible: All missions without a fixed boss can spawn roaming terminus. Spawn is not player-controlled.
terminus_rules.huntmaster_role: Huntmaster flags terminus as a campaign target. Champion calls the engagement. Roaming still spawns regardless — Huntmaster + Champion call determines whether it counts as a prestige terminus kill.

operations.name: Inferno
operations.description: Blow up a promethium refinery to thin the Tyranid swarm.

operations.name: Decapitation
operations.description: Rig a bridge for detonation to eliminate the Hive Tyrant leading the swarm at the Astropathic Relay.

operations.name: Vox Liberatis
operations.description: Battle the Thousand Sons and uncover what is jamming vox communications.

operations.name: Reliquary
operations.description: Infiltrate a captured Ecclesiarchy compound and destroy the Warp Beacon summoning Chaos reinforcements.

operations.name: Fall of Atreus
operations.description: Find the Sword of Atreus Battle Barge and prepare it for launch.

operations.name: Ballistic Engine
operations.description: Weaken the Tyranid swarm using a Nova Cannon Warhead delivered by train.

operations.name: Termination
operations.description: Reactivate an abandoned Imperial fortress's defensive systems to destroy Tyranid capillary towers.

operations.name: Obelisk
operations.description: Return to the burial world of Demerium to destroy a source of chaotic energy. Introduces Tzaangor Enlightened.

operations.name: Exfiltration
operations.description: Retrieve a Tech-Priest who refused withdrawal orders from an AdMech facility.

operations.name: Vortex
operations.terminus_note: Intel Lapse forced for wave faction. Mutalith Vortex Beast terminus target is unchanged — it is a sealed Chaos entity, not a reinforcement wave.
operations.description: Investigate and cleanse the Astropathic Relay of heretical presence.

operations.name: Reclamation
operations.description: Board the overrun cruiser Wrath of Espandor and destabilise its reactors to devastate the Hive Fleet.

operations.name: Disruption
operations.description: Reinforce the Cadian defence and prevent the Thousand Sons from completing a ritual at the Ecclesiarchy cathedral.

operations.name: Purgation
operations.description: Reclaim an Adeptus Mechanicus facility in the Kadaku swamps and secure Nozick's research.

operations.name: Siege
operations.description: Horde defence of an Imperial fortress against escalating waves. Stratagems are not permitted in this mode.
operations.notes: Distinct game mode — not a standard operation. No strats. Not eligible for prestige missions or KT doctrine locking.
